hypothesis.statement: The twin site at +0x6c4 still carries the last range check, and probe F's failure NAMES why the i-loop cure does not transfer verbatim. At the i-loop the two spellings were genuinely different KINDS of access — a walked pointer `p->state` against an indexed `PTA(i)->state` — and MWCC emitted two loads. At the twin the `!= 0` read is ALREADY the indexed `PT(j)->state`, so spelling the 2/3 pair `PTA(j)->state` offers no second KIND and probe F merely added lwzx without splitting the CSE. The aligned view at +0x6bc shows the target reading the 2/3 pair through `add r3,r31,r27` + `lwz r0,3368(r3)` (index form) while OURS reads `232(r20)` (a materialized base). So the untried form is the MIRROR of the i-loop fix: give the twin loops a WALKED pointer for the `!= 0` test — `for (j = 0, q = PT(0); j < 4; j++, q++)` with `(st = q->state) != 0` — and leave the 2/3 pair as the indexed `PT(j)->state`. That supplies the two different KINDS the i-loop needed, in the same direction the target's own bases run.
